question: What outcome regarding age and death follows from abstaining from food by day?
premises: A practice of not eating by day is specified.
This practice leads to a future outcome.
The outcome concerns age and death.
inference: By abstaining from food during the day, one will go to the death of age.
uncertainties: vayo-mṛtyuṃ interpreted as death related to aging; exact sense uncertain
plain_english: By not eating during the day, one will go to the death of old age.
